title: Ash-Court Betrayal: Realm Answer
description: Ash-Court Betrayal unfolds across ash-court gallery where bargain traps split risk from reward, pushing a 5-Titan Infernal Dominion squad to prove aggression, debuffs, pulls, execution, burn pressure, power through risk. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: Ash-Court Betrayal: Realm Answer advances Cinders of Dominion: The Black Iron Court turns Gate wounds into bargains, proving ambition can defend a Realm only when power accepts consequence. It directly tests the faction tension: They can weaponize catastrophe better than any Realm, but every alliance with them asks who will hold the chain afterward.
terrain: ash-court gallery where bargain traps split risk from reward
